name: CORE
description: CORE was a predominantly white street gang active in Chicago's Lincoln Park neighborhood during the 1960s. The group congregated along Armitage Avenue near Lincoln and engaged in conflicts with the Cabrini Green Projects and the Latin Kings. They were allied with other North Side Chicago gangs, including the Gaylords.
